query: Our assistant uses fewer tokens after a model downgrade but retries more often. Compare total attributable spend per verified successful task, success rate, abstentions, and p95 completion latency.
Profile a tool-using agent that takes twelve model turns to answer simple requests. Measure call and retrieval time, reduce unnecessary loops, and keep quality and safety gates intact.
Choose model routing for easy versus hard agent tasks using current measured evidence. Include failed small-model calls, escalation charges, latency, and an explicit ceiling on fallback attempts.
Design enforced run budgets for a planner with parallel workers. Reserve aggregate spend and calls centrally, preserve limits across restarts, and return honest partial results when exhausted.
We want to cache AI workflow results without leaking across tenants or reusing stale permissions. Define keys, versioning, expiry, invalidation, charges, and a quality-gated cost experiment.
Compare independent read parallelism with sequential calls in our assistant. Measure critical-path and tail latency under rate limits and concurrency caps without reordering dependent mutations.
A document assistant spends most of its context on duplicate chunks. Test reducing context and tool payloads while measuring groundedness, retrieval recall, total spend, and successful outcomes.
Calculate economics for two agent variants using all attempts, retries, cache reads, and worker overhead. Handle zero successes correctly and distinguish response latency from final completion time.
Our offline AI tagging workflow can tolerate delay. Evaluate batching and queue time, retry blast radius, throughput, cost per success, and whether the quality floor survives the change.
Set up a before-and-after experiment for an expensive agent. Pin versions and pricing timestamp, compare matched tasks and cache conditions, and keep only gains beyond measurement noise.
Profile a conventional dashboard with slow database queries, large images, and poor interaction latency. Measure the actual bottleneck and verify improvements without any model or agent spending.

Design event fields capturing model tokens, tool time, worker spans, cache status, and evaluator outcomes. We need accurate agent instrumentation; optimization choices and budget policy are already settled.

Create an agent quality benchmark with representative tasks, safety violations, abstention, repeated runs, and uncertainty. Operational costs are fixed constraints; the request is scoring and release thresholds.

Rewrite a production prompt to remove contradictory instructions and add missing-evidence behavior. Keep the existing cost ceilings and evaluation contract rather than designing an economics experiment.

Evaluate whether two runtime agents outperform one worker, then specify handoffs, fan-in, cancellation, shared-state ownership, and central budgets. The main decision is coordination necessity and correctness.

Design the retry policy for unknown external commits and transient failures, including reconciliation, backoff, durable budgets, and poison-task handling. Recovery correctness is the requested outcome.

Compare sparse, dense, hybrid, and reranked retrieval for unsupported citations. Use relevance labels and oracle evidence to isolate pipeline failures; general agent routing and spending are outside scope.

Our authorization gate permits individually valid operations that collectively exceed a reserve. Implement atomic aggregate admission and version checks, using fixed runtime budgets rather than profiling economics.
Shorten this one-off prompt so I can paste it into a chat window while preserving its meaning. No production workflow, verified outcomes, pricing measurements, or release decision is involved.

Review approval batching and standing grants to reduce human friction in an agent workflow. Specify exact previews, reviewer authority, expiration, and changed-action behavior, keeping model costs unchanged.
